topic: Divergence and Curl: Visualizing Vector Fields

sections.title: Introduction: What is a Vector Field?
lecture_lines: Vector fields assign vectors to space points.
Imagine particles flowing in a steady current.
Arrows represent velocity at every coordinate.
animations: Define a function mapping space coordinates to vectors using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/particle.svg].
Display a grid of vectors on background #000000 representing a flow field.
Highlight a single vector in bright yellow #FFFF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/current.svg].

sections.title: Divergence: The Source and Sink
lecture_lines: Positive divergence means a source spreads out.
Negative divergence means a sink concentrates inward.
animations: Explain divergence as net outward flow.
Draw a source with outward vectors #00FF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/faucet.svg].
Draw a sink with inward vectors #FF0000 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/drain.svg].

sections.title: Curl: The Rotation Factor
lecture_lines: Curl measures microscopic rotation at points.
A spinning paddlewheel indicates non-zero curl.
The curl vector points along rotation axes.
animations: Visualize a paddle wheel in the field #FFA500.
Rotate the wheel to indicate curl direction.

sections.title: The Unified Visual Test
lecture_lines: Inspect fields with two simple tests.
animations: Apply visual tests to a flow field using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/balloon.svg].
Overlay curl and divergence operators on the flow field.
Animate divergence magnitude changing around a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/propeller.svg].

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Curl detects the rotation of fields.
These concepts underpin fundamental physical laws.
animations: Summarize divergence and curl key roles.
